LocationTracking.indicator_tooltip_body: Your location is shared every 15 minutes while you are checked in. It stops automatically at check-out.
LocationTracking.privacy_page_title: Location tracking — what we collect and when
LocationTracking.privacy_page_when: We only track your device location while you are checked into a shift. Tracking starts at check-in and stops at check-out. We never track you outside of a work session.
LocationTracking.privacy_page_what: Every 15 minutes we capture your latitude and longitude, the GPS accuracy reported by your device, and optionally your battery level. That's it — no continuous route recording, no microphone, no other sensors.
LocationTracking.privacy_page_ios: On iPhone, location updates only while the app is open in the foreground. Backgrounded tabs are paused by iOS; this is a platform limitation we cannot work around in a web app.
LocationTracking.privacy_page_retention: Pings are kept for 30 days and then deleted automatically. They are used by your supervisor to verify on-site presence and by admins for operational audits.
LocationTracking.privacy_page_who: Your pings are visible only to you, your assigned supervisors, and platform admins. They are never shared with clients.
LocationTracking.permission_denied_toast: We need location permission to verify your on-site presence.
